system.description:
The rarest pact, granted only when he sees something worth possessing.

  • Patron boon: You learn the name, face and one secret of anyone you have made a bargain with, sealed by word or hand, each side giving something of value.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Asmodeus in the World of Arneyan wiki.
